description: Record audio with your microphone, play it back and download it as a file.

faqs.a: Click "Start recording" and allow microphone access when the browser asks. The timer shows the recording length; click "Stop" to finish.
The download uses WebM (usually Opus audio), the most widely supported format for browser recording. It plays in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and most media players.
The browser blocks microphone access without permission, on insecure pages, or when no mic is present. Serve the page over HTTPS (or localhost) and check your system mic settings.
faqs.q: Why do I get a microphone error?

faqs.a: No. Recording and encoding happen entirely in your browser; audio never leaves your device.

howto: Click "Start recording" and allow microphone access.
Speak — the live timer shows elapsed time.
Play back your recording below, then download it as a .webm file.
title: Voice Recorder
